info.name: PetMedicalEvents
info.description: Medical events for a pet (/pets/{petId}/medicalEvents). PROPOSED DESIGN: The nested controller does not exist yet (see PRERREQUISITOS_BACKEND.md). SELF-CONTAINED COLLECTION: The initial events are the arrival events registered when creating the pet; this collection does not use the MedicalEvent collection. Isolation limitation: MedicalEventService requires an existing veterinarian when CREATING a medical event, and there is no way to create one without another companion. Therefore, successful creation is optional ({{veterinarian_id}}); querying, editing, and deleting are tested completely.
